name: Tomoe Watanabe
source: Brash and brazen Tomoe has seemingly made it her life's goal to harass and torment Noriko at every opportunity. Perhaps she doesn't like Noriko's attitude, or perhaps she's simply jealous–either way, Noriko is becoming extremely tired of the constant bullying.
